text:
304 days from 1504-03-25.  
1504 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100).  
March 25 + 304 days:  
Days left in March: 6 (since 31 - 25 = 6).  
April–December: count days.  

Better: add 304 days stepwise:  
March 25 + 280 days = December 30 (since 280 days from March 25 is Dec 30 in leap year).  
304 - 280 = 24 more days → Dec 30 + 24 days = Jan 23 next year.  
Year becomes 1505.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1505-01-23
